arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Draw a three-panel pencil storyboard (not final painting), horizontal panels stacked. Scene 1 Indian shop: small tan Neet stands proudly full body beside boxed Kothi fireworks on low shelf; larger charcoal Buddy at his side looks toward marigold plant two blooms one stem behind him. Scene 2 at house back door at night: Buddy stands and touches closed door with one forepaw, other three supporting; Neet crouched separately looks offscreen toward distant noise; no firework near dogs. Scene 3 quiet living room: Neet sprawled on rug, Buddy supported on separate floor cushion, both bodies fully visible; cropped seated humans on couch behind, woman purple sweater holding kulfi and man holding chai. No lettering. Original photo input roles: Neet standing and rest anatomy, Buddy standing and resting face. Generated last image provisional style only. Use continuous connected torso spine pelvis and individual owned limbs; fine legs and narrow full torso Neet, substantial long legs and moderately elongated torso Buddy. Smooth body surfaces. No curly or engraved hair texture; Buddy regional muzzle brows ears only. All photos limited to visible uncalibrated pose, not exact measurements or motion. N35 excluded anatomy B08 styling only B25 unavailable B30 supplemental rest; not included. Humans provisional. Clear construction and ground contacts.
